title: Conditional κ = 0.003128645 (+2.59e-7 over #6144): retain an operand to remove a root stop
body:
Reader 451 previously needed helper 228 at frame 737 before it read root 772. This forced the root to visit frame 737. The new word saves that operand in an unused lifetime of register 770, reads the root at frame 595 first, then adds the saved operand at frame 737 and clears it.

**Conditional κ = 0.003128645, +0.000000259 over #6144.** The raw crossing is strictly between 0.00312865201590 and 0.00312865201591. The local paid change is `H1 − H2 − H4 + H5`; the complete caller uses it 18 times. All productive targets, 29 owned register labels and peak storage 13 stay unchanged.
